source:
@@U03753@@
Oh, what a relentless fate pursues me!
Why am I condemned to confound men’s hearts
so that they spare nothing,
neither themselves nor anything of worth?
Abducting, seducing, fighting,
they dragged me this way and that,
demigods, heroes, gods, even demons,
led me astray, wandering, every which way.
Even as one I perplexed the world,
and twice again when I was double,
And now that I am three- and fourfold,
all I bring is calamity after calamity.
Set this good man free.
Folly caused by a god is no disgrace.

@@U03755@@
Your beauty, great Queen,
is a sure-shooting archer,
and there lies the victim, wounded.
But now those arrows,
arrow following arrow,
strike me, too, and I sense
their feathered flight from every side,
crisscrossing through castle and court.
What am I now?
In an instant
you turn my staunchest defenders to rebels,
making my very walls unsafe.
How can I not fear that my army will follow
the unvanquished vanquisher?
What choice have I
but to surrender to you myself
and all that in my delusion I once thought mine?
Freely and faithfully,
I confess myself here at your feet
your subject forever,
you who had only to appear
to assume my throne and my kingdom.
translation:
@@U03753@@
噢，命运是多么无情地追赶着我啊！
为什么我注定要迷惑人心
以至于他们不遗余力，
既不是他们自己，也不是任何有价值的东西？
绑架、引诱、打斗，
他们把我拖来拖去，
半神、英雄、诸神，甚至恶魔，
让我误入歧途，四处徘徊。
即使我作为一个人迷惑了世界，
当我变成双倍时，又两次，
现在我已经是三倍和四倍了，
我带来的只是一个接一个的灾难。
释放这个好人。
上帝造成的愚蠢并不可耻。

@@U03755@@
您的美丽，伟大的女王，
是一位精准的弓箭手，
受害者躺在那里，受伤了。
但现在那些箭头，
箭头跟随箭头，
我也感到震惊，我感觉到
它们的羽毛从四面八方飞来，
纵横交错地穿过城堡和宫廷。
我现在是什么？
瞬间
你把我最坚定的捍卫者变成了叛徒，
让我的墙壁变得不安全。
我怎能不担心我的军队会追随
不败的征服者？
我有什么选择
但我自己却臣服于你
以及我曾经认为是我的错觉中的一切？
自由而忠实地，
我在你的脚下承认自己
你永远的主题，
只须出现的你
继承我的王位和王国。
